title: Smart Data Models - AIXM - Runway
description: <font color="#333333">A defined rectangular area on a land or a water aerodrome/heliport prepared for the landing and take-off of aircraft. Note: this includes the concept of Final Approach and Take-Off Area (FATO) for helicopters.</font> (AIXM 5.2 feature Runway. One NGSI-LD entity per AIXM feature; its attributes are the properties of one TimeSlice, normally the current BASELINE, flattened at entity level, with validTime and the other TimeSlice properties kept as attributes. Property names kept verbatim; nested AIXM <<object>> types keep their structure.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Runway:<gml:identifier UUID>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Runway'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

identifier.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeature.html#identifier'. gml:identifier of the AIXM feature (codeSpace urn:uuid:): a UUID that stays the same in every TimeSlice of the feature. The NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:<feature>:<identifier>.

endPosition.description: gml:endPosition of the gml:TimePeriod. Absent when the end is indeterminate (indeterminatePosition='unknown'), i.e. until further notice.

validTime.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#validTime'. gml:validTime of the TimeSlice whose properties are carried by this entity: the period during which these values are effective. The efffectivity of the TimeSlice.

interpretation.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#interpretation'. Property indicating how the timeslice is to be interpreted. See the AIXM Temporality model for details. Normally BASELINE (or SNAPSHOT) for an NGSI-LD entity, which carries the full state of the feature.

sequenceNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#sequenceNumber'. Used for the identification of the Time Slice concerned. See the AIXM Temporality model for details.

correctionNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#correctionNumber'. Used for indicating the order of the corrections of a Time Slice. See the AIXM Temporality model for details.

endPosition.description: gml:endPosition of the gml:TimePeriod. Absent when the end is indeterminate (indeterminatePosition='unknown'), i.e. until further notice.

featureLifetime.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#featureLifetime'. The start and end of life of the feature. See the AIXM Temporality model for details.

designator.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_Runway.html#designator'. The designator of a runway, used to uniquely identify it at an airport/heliport.

aixmType.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_Runway.html#type'. AIXM property 'type', renamed to aixmType (NGSI-LD reserved term). The type can be either runway for airplanes or Final Approach and Take-off Area (FATO) for helicopters. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

ElevatedSurface.description: AIXM geometry ElevatedSurface. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_ElevatedSurface.html'. A 2-dimensional primitive and is composed of one or more surface patches as specified in ISO 19107:2003, 6.3.17.1, which is extended with properties that represent the vertical position (elevation, datum, accuracy).

geometry.description: The GML geometry of the AIXM ElevatedSurface (gml:pos / gml:posList, EPSG:4326) encoded as GeoJSON (longitude, latitude order). Smart Data Models encoding of the GML part; arcs and circles (ArcByCenterPoint, CircleByCenterPoint) must be densified to positions.

elevation.description: The vertical distance of the surface level measured from Mean Sea Level (MSL). Units: given by uom.

geoidUndulation.description: The distance of the geoid above (positive) or below (negative) the mathematical reference ellipsoid at the location of the surface. Units: given by uom.

LinguisticNote.description: AIXM <<object>> LinguisticNote. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_LinguisticNote.html'. The note content expressed in a specific language. As a minimum, all Notes shall be expressed in English.

Note.description: AIXM <<object>> Note. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_Note.html'. A general text note for a feature or for one of its properties.

purpose.description: An indication of the goal which led to the provision of the free text note. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

side.description: The side of the runway where the ridge of deposited material is located. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

frictionCoefficient.description: The average ratio of the weight of an object being moved along an airport/heliport surface with contamination and the force that maintains contact between the object and that surface.

frictionEstimation.description: A qualitative estimate of the friction on an airport/heliport surface with contamination. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

furtherClearanceTime.description: The time when it is expected to complete further clearance of an airport/heliport surface with contamination.

proportion.description: The percentage of the contaminated area of the overall extent of the surface.

criticalRidge.description: Identifies the critical bank associated to the contaminant.

SurfaceCharacteristics.description: AIXM <<object>> SurfaceCharacteristics. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_SurfaceCharacteristics.html'. An entity grouping together the attributes that model characteristics of an airport surface, such as strength, material, etc.

composition.description: The type of the predominant material of which a surface of the movement area is composed. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

evaluationMethodPCN.description: The method used to rate a runway pavement. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

classLCN.description: A value which denotes the peak bearing moment the surface can handle repeatedly without shortening its service life.

An operationally significant contaminant of homogeneous type such as snow, ice, slush, water, sand, etc., which is present on a large surface of the airport/heliport area.

layerOrder.description: The order of the layer (starting from the uppermost, towards the movement area surface), in case overlapping contaminants are present.

type.description: The type of contaminating substance on the movement area surface. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

extent.description: The surface covered by the contamination. For runways this can be a runway third, such as in the current SNOWTAM reporting style..
